en: Colorized vintage view of a formal flower garden in a city park. A woman in early 20th‑century clothing stands on a gravel path bordered by colorful flowerbeds. White wooden pergolas and benches line the left side, while manicured lawns and more flowerbeds extend into the distance under a blue sky. Printed red text at the top identifies the scene as a flower garden in the city park of Chemnitz.
